review.images: Used source renders of the Terraces architecture and the distinctive Terraces clubhouse, spa, gym and living spaces. Aldar publishes several matching bedroom, kitchen and bathroom images in both Fahid brochures. Those shared renders were excluded.
review.location: The right masterplan panel on physical page 7 identifies this release separately from Fahid Beach Residences and The Beach House. Page 8 prints five times. They also agree with Aldar’s Terraces launch location section at https://www.aldar.com/properties/en/Fahid-Island/fahidbeachterraces.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed sixteen complete unit layouts on the eight physical spreads 33–40. Building floorplate pages 27–31 remain accessible in the PDF. No whole-unit total is printed on the displayed sheets.

unavailable: Confirmed building entrances and signed unit total areas.
